## Context / Problem
On October 6, 7 of the first 15 hourly bridge runs failed at the 120s ACLI Done-ticket search; run 37541199419 later failed identically. AWS rebar-bridge-run-failures alarmed. AcliClient.search_issues (adapters/jira/acli.py) downloads the complete JQL result with --paginate before slicing; fetcher._DONE_RECENT_CAP=1000 therefore does not bound network work. Live REST probe: 5,276 Done issues, 53 pages, 34,960,514 bytes; first 1000 took 7.047s versus 33.503s for all results. Local ACLI --limit 1000 took 24.361s. Evidence is in linked investigation loony-osmophilic-bass and comments.
## Approach
Replace eager CLI search with demand-driven REST cursor pagination using the existing Jira search endpoint and transport. Preserve search_issues(jql,start_at,max_results), requested fields/order, per-JQL memoization and invalidate_search_cache. For each JQL, retain a consumed-issue list and a suspended cursor iterator together. A request extends that list only until start_at+max_results issues are cached, or the cursor is exhausted, then returns cached[start_at:start_at+max_results]. An earlier/out-of-order slice reads the cached prefix; a forward jump consumes cursor pages up to that offset. Never send startAt to Jira. Reaching the fetcher cap stops further search calls and therefore further HTTP requests. Per-JQL/full invalidation discards both list and cursor. The existing REST cursor helper enforces progress internally; no client token attribute is needed. Use existing _iter_cursor_pages guard and AcliRestMixin._direct_rest_post_json rather than introducing a backend, dependency or configuration. Keep cursor progress checked before emitting a stalled page. Reject malformed search responses; invalidate a partially failed search so a later attempt cannot silently reuse a truncated result. Preserve negative-result caching and cache independence across JQLs. Preserve other Cloud reads/writes and Data Center behavior. Do not increase the timeout or suppress failure metrics. Existing REST retries handle transient network timeout/connection errors. HTTP errors (including transient 429/503) propagate after one HTTP attempt and fail the current pass; malformed responses and cursor stalls are fatal to that search/pass. No retry wrapper is added. Cache eviction permits a later explicit search or scheduled pass to begin fresh. If merged-main validation regresses, keep the incident open and use a Gerrit revert of this change as the back-out path; the preserved method signature allows restoring the old transport without data migration.
## Scope
src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/acli.py: demand-driven search/cache. adapters/jira/acli_graph.py: existing cursor validation before page delivery if required. tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_acli_search_cache_freshness.py: existing memo behavior at REST seam. New test_acli_search_pagination.py: transport paging regressions. state/test_acli_subprocess_timeout.py: remove migrated REST read from subprocess-only census. Update test_cloud_rate_limit_sweep_heldout.py to classify new read helpers. tests/interfaces/conftest.py supplies a loopback REST search fixture, consumed by facades/test_bridge_programmatic_e2e_heldout.py and store/test_bridge_preview_under_sync_contention_heldout.py. Preserve their no-write and lock-free assertions. Amend stale search-path documentation where directly affected.
## Testing
Regression with 5,276 simulated Done issues must reach the real AcliClient through fetch_paging.collect(cap=1000), return exactly 1000, and request only those pages; pre-fix path must fail. Cover continued active pagination, short and empty pages with live cursor, cursor stall, out-of-order slice calls, per-query/full invalidation, negative cache, HTTP/malformed-response failure and retry without partial-cache poisoning. Run affected Cloud/fetch tests, make verify, and normal Gerrit review/CI gates. Live read probe compares bounded returned keys and fields to baseline; run the merged main workflow and inspect actual reconcile result and telemetry.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Real Cloud search lazily fetches requested slices while preserving fields, order, cache freshness and uncapped active traversal; focused tests pass, including cap regression failing on old behavior.
- [ ] Failed or stalled page reads fail loudly without returning a partial successful result; error/recovery tests pass.
- [ ] make verify passes and the change merges through LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, no unresolved comments.
- [ ] [non-codebase] Record live bounded-query timing/count evidence, successful merged-main bridge runs and AWS alarm OK with Seattle timestamps. Recurring timeout path is removed; incidental unrelated warnings are accounted for explicitly.
